martin.docs: Heads-up: we're changing the streaming response framing for text/generation endpoints from NDJSON lines to a framed JSON envelope format. This affects SDK streaming parsers and some proxy/gateway setups.

Why: NDJSON made it hard to include out-of-band control messages (partial-metadata, stream-resets) without hacks. New format uses simple length-prefixed JSON frames: each frame is `<len>\n<json>` so consumers can robustly parse mixed payloads.

High-level migration plan:
- Rollout to hosted API next week behind a feature flag.
- 30-day compatibility window where both NDJSON and framed formats are accepted.
- SDKs will default to auto-detect and parse either format during the window, then default to framed-only after cutoff.
- Docs/examples will show the framed format going forward. Migration guide: https://redwood.internal/migrations/streaming-frame-format

ellie.sdk: Implementation note: JS/py SDK streaming helpers will try to auto-detect the first bytes. Pseudocode: if first token contains '{' and a newline-number prefix, assume framed, else fallback to NDJSON. We'll land patches that add `streaming_format='auto'|'ndjson'|'framed'` param.

frank.eng: Runtime detail: server emits header `X-Redwood-Stream-Format: framed|ndjson` for transparent detection. Proxies that buffer by-lines may need update; we should call out common middleware (nginx chunked buffering, some corp proxies).

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary -> global over 36h once SDK patches are published. Docs rebuild scheduled right after global flip.

support: Please prepare two KB snippets: 1) how to detect the format (header + first-bytes), 2) quick fixes for common proxy issues (nginx `proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on;`). I'll draft and link.

tim.product: Product note: we should add a short blurb for the Console changelog and notify AMs for customers using streaming at scale. Some enterprise setups might require firewall/proxy changes.

ellie.sdk: Example client change (JS):
```js
// old NDJSON iterator
for await (const line of client.streamGenerate(...)) {
  const obj = JSON.parse(line)
  // handle token/metadata
}
// new framed parser (auto-detect)
for await (const frame of client.streamGenerate(..., {streaming_format: 'auto'})) {
  // frame is already parsed JSON, supports control messages
}
```

martin.docs: Action list:
- [x] Migration guide published (martin)
- [ ] SDK patches: auto-detect + explicit param (ellie)
- [ ] Runtime header + feature-flag rollout (frank)
- [ ] KB for proxies & support replies (support)
- [ ] AM-facing note + Console changelog (tim)
If you own an unchecked item, drop a :thumbsup: and paste the PR/issue link here. We'll review in the weekly SDK sync. Thanks!
